scripts.clean:all: npm run clean -w web && rm -rf node_modules .firebase
scripts.firebase:use: bash -lc 'set -a; : ${PRIVATE_DIR:?PRIVATE_DIR must be set}; COMMON_ENV="$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/common.env"; FRONTEND_ENV="$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env"; [ -f "$COMMON_ENV" ] && . "$COMMON_ENV" || true; [ -f "$FRONTEND_ENV" ] && . "$FRONTEND_ENV" || true; set +a; : ${PROJECT_ID:?PROJECT_ID must be set}; npm exec -w web firebase -- use "$PROJECT_ID"'
scripts.firebase:create: bash -lc 'set -a; : ${PRIVATE_DIR:?PRIVATE_DIR must be set}; COMMON_ENV="$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/common.env"; FRONTEND_ENV="$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env"; [ -f "$COMMON_ENV" ] && . "$COMMON_ENV" || true; [ -f "$FRONTEND_ENV" ] && . "$FRONTEND_ENV" || true; set +a; : ${PROJECT_ID:?PROJECT_ID must be set}; npm exec -w web firebase -- projects:create "$PROJECT_ID" --display-name "$PROJECT_ID"'
scripts.firebase:deploy: bash -lc 'set -a; : ${PRIVATE_DIR:?PRIVATE_DIR must be set}; COMMON_ENV="$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/common.env"; FRONTEND_ENV="$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env"; [ -f "$COMMON_ENV" ] && . "$COMMON_ENV" || true; [ -f "$FRONTEND_ENV" ] && . "$FRONTEND_ENV" || true; set +a; : ${PROJECT_ID:?PROJECT_ID must be set}; npm run build -w web && npm exec -w web firebase -- deploy --project "$PROJECT_ID"'
scripts.firebase:hosting:disable: bash -lc 'set -a; : ${PRIVATE_DIR:?PRIVATE_DIR must be set}; COMMON_ENV="$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/common.env"; FRONTEND_ENV="$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env"; [ -f "$COMMON_ENV" ] && . "$COMMON_ENV" || true; [ -f "$FRONTEND_ENV" ] && . "$FRONTEND_ENV" || true; set +a; : ${PROJECT_ID:?PROJECT_ID must be set}; npm exec -w web firebase -- hosting:disable --project "$PROJECT_ID"'
